vibe.verdict: Right place and right lines from Wooderson and Pink, but it sits on a generic diner card and leaves out the night's best scenes.
missing: Mailbox baseball and the man with the gun
The paint dumped on O'Bannion at the Emporium
Pink and Wooderson on the 50-yard line, 'keep livin'
The road trip to Houston for Aerosmith tickets
Mitch and Julie making out on the hill, with 'Slow Ride' at the end
ideas: Swap 'Moon tower chips' note for Slater's Moon Tower story.
Swap 'Emporium chilli butter beer nuts' note for the paint on O'Bannion.
Swap 'Texas salt and pepper brisket' note for 'Mailbox baseball, and the man with the gun.'
Swap the 'Hot coffee, homemade pie' line for 'Last day of school, 28 May 1976' to drop the diner cliche.
